title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

series.title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

fullText.simplified:
九、回家的路

    小朋友特别喜欢米乐，要带他回家。米乐看见小朋友的爸爸妈妈也走了过来，他害怕极了。他不想跟别人回家，他不要新主人。米乐飞快地跑了起来，他从大家的身边跑过，他从小门上跳了过去！这一次，他做到了！他跑得越来越远，越来越远……
    米乐很担心，也很害怕。这里离季南的家远吗？他能找到回家的路吗？饿了吃什么？渴了喝什么？米乐想着这些问题，跑到了马路中间。突然，一辆车开过，飞快地开向米乐，米乐马上往后走了几步。他又想起很多年前，自己也是这样跑到马路中间，季南为了保护他，跑到了车前。很多辆车突然停了下来，米乐看见季南在地上，他的腿下都是红色。那时候，米乐害怕极了。也是从那时候开始，米乐告诉自己：“我也要保护季南，保护季南的家人，我一定要一直在季南身边！”想到了这些，米乐没有那么害怕了，他开始慢慢地找回家的路……
    米乐饿了，就去吃别人扔了的东西；米乐渴了，就去喝地上的雨水；米乐累了，就在纸箱子里睡觉。他身上的毛现在都是黑色的了。他东闻闻西闻闻，有的地方他已经去过了，但是走了几天又回到了那里。每一次他害怕的时候，每一次他难过的时候，每一次他不知道怎么办的时候，米乐都告诉自己季南在等他，他觉得自己可以看见季南的脸，可以听见季南的声音：
    “米乐，快过来！我在这里。”
    “米乐，好狗，快来！我们一起玩！”
    “米乐，和你在一起，我太高兴了！”
fullText.traditional:
九、回家的路

    小朋友特別喜歡米樂，要帶他回家。米樂看見小朋友的爸爸媽媽也走了過來，他害怕極了。他不想跟別人回家，他不要新主人。米樂飛快地跑了起來，他從大家的身邊跑過，他從小門上跳了過去！這一次，他做到了！他跑得越來越遠，越來越遠……
    米樂很擔心，也很害怕。這裡離季南的家遠嗎？他能找到回家的路嗎？餓了吃什麼？渴了喝什麼？米樂想著這些問題，跑到了馬路中間。突然，一輛車開過，飛快地開向米樂，米樂馬上往後走了幾步。他又想起很多年前，自己也是這樣跑到馬路中間，季南為了保護他，跑到了車前。很多輛車突然停了下來，米樂看見季南在地上，他的腿下都是紅色。那時候，米樂害怕極了。也是從那時候開始，米樂告訴自己：“我也要保護季南，保護季南的家人，我一定要一直在季南身邊！”想到了這些，米樂沒有那麼害怕了，他開始慢慢地找回家的路……
    米樂餓了，就去吃別人扔了的東西；米樂渴了，就去喝地上的雨水；米樂累了，就在紙箱子裡睡覺。他身上的毛現在都是黑色的了。他東聞聞西聞聞，有的地方他已經去過了，但是走了幾天又回到了那裡。每一次他害怕的時候，每一次他難過的時候，每一次他不知道怎麼辦的時候，米樂都告訴自己季南在等他，他覺得自己可以看見季南的臉，可以聽見季南的聲音：
    “米樂，快過來！我在這裡。”
    “米樂，好狗，快來！我們一起玩！”
    “米樂，和你在一起，我太高興了！”

sentences.simplified: 小朋友特别喜欢米乐，要带他回家。
sentences.traditional: 小朋友特別喜歡米樂，要帶他回家。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo péng you tè bié xǐ huan mǐ lè yào dài tā huí jiā
sentences.english: The child really liked Mi Le and wanted to take him home.

sentences.simplified: 米乐看见小朋友的爸爸妈妈也走了过来，他害怕极了。
sentences.traditional: 米樂看見小朋友的爸爸媽媽也走了過來，他害怕極了。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè kàn jiàn xiǎo péng you de bà bà mā mā yě zǒu le guò lái tā hài pà jí le
sentences.english: When he saw that the child’s mom and dad were also coming over, Mi Le was terrified.

sentences.simplified: 他不想跟别人回家，他不要新主人。
sentences.traditional: 他不想跟別人回家，他不要新主人。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù xiǎng gēn bié ren huí jiā tā bú yào xīn zhǔ rén
sentences.english: He was not willing to go home with anyone else. He did not want a new owner.

sentences.simplified: 米乐飞快地跑了起来，他从大家的身边跑过，他从小门上跳了过去！
sentences.traditional: 米樂飛快地跑了起來，他從大家的身邊跑過，他從小門上跳了過去！
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè fēi kuài de pǎo le qǐ lái tā cóng dà jiā de shēn biān pǎo guò tā cóng xiǎo mén shang tiào le guò qu
sentences.english: Mi Le started running at lightning speed. He ran past everyone. He jumped over the little gate! This time, he did it!

sentences.simplified: 这一次，他做到了！他跑得越来越远，越来越远……
sentences.traditional: 這一次，他做到了！他跑得越來越遠，越來越遠……
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì tā zuò dào le tā pǎo de yuè lái yuè yuǎn yuè lái yuè yuǎn
sentences.english: He ran farther and farther away, farther and farther away …

sentences.simplified: 米乐很担心，也很害怕。这里离季南的家远吗？他能找到回家的路吗？
sentences.traditional: 米樂很擔心，也很害怕。這裡離季南的家遠嗎？他能找到回家的路嗎？
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè hěn dān xīn yě hěn hài pà zhè lǐ lí jì nán de jiā yuǎn ma tā néng zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù ma
sentences.english: Mi Le was worried and scared. Was this place far from Ji Nan’s house? Could he find his way home?

sentences.simplified: 饿了吃什么？渴了喝什么？
sentences.traditional: 餓了吃什麼？渴了喝什麼？
sentences.pinyin: è le chī shén me kě le hē shén me
sentences.english: What should he eat when he’s hungry? What should he drink when he’s thirsty?

sentences.simplified: 米乐想着这些问题，跑到了马路中间。
sentences.traditional: 米樂想著這些問題，跑到了馬路中間。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè xiǎng zhe zhè xiē wèn tí pǎo dào le mǎ lù zhōng jiān
sentences.english: Mi Le thought about these problems. He ran into the middle of the road.

sentences.simplified: 突然，一辆车开过，飞快地开向米乐，米乐马上往后走了几步。
sentences.traditional: 突然，一輛車開過，飛快地開向米樂，米樂馬上往後走了幾步。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán yí liàng chē kāi guò fēi kuài de kāi xiàng mǐ lè mǐ lè mǎ shàng wǎng hòu zǒu le jǐ bù
sentences.english: Suddenly, a car came. The car drove toward Mi Le at lightning speed. Mi Le immediately took several steps backward.

sentences.simplified: 他又想起很多年前，自己也是这样跑到马路中间，
sentences.traditional: 他又想起很多年前，自己也是這樣跑到馬路中間，
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu xiǎng qǐ hěn duō nián qián zì jǐ yě shì zhè yàng pǎo dào mǎ lù zhōng jiān
sentences.english: He remembered again that many years ago, he’d also run like this into the middle of the road, ..

sentences.simplified: 季南为了保护他，跑到了车前。
sentences.traditional: 季南為了保護他，跑到了車前。
sentences.pinyin: jì nán wèi le bǎo hù tā pǎo dào le chē qián
sentences.english: .. and Ji Nan had run out in front of the car in order to protect him.

sentences.simplified: 很多辆车突然停了下来，米乐看见季南在地上，他的腿下都是红色。那时候，米乐害怕极了。
sentences.traditional: 很多輛車突然停了下來，米樂看見季南在地上，他的腿下都是紅色。那時候，米樂害怕極了。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō liàng chē tū rán tíng le xià lai mǐ lè kàn jiàn jì nán zài dì shang tā de tuǐ xià dōu shì hóng sè nà shí hou mǐ lè hài pà jí le
sentences.english: Many cars suddenly stopped. Mi Le saw Ji Nan on the ground. It was all red under his legs. Mi Le had been terrified then.

sentences.simplified: 也是从那时候开始，米乐告诉自己：“我也要保护季南，保护季南的家人，我一定要一直在季南身边！”
sentences.traditional: 也是從那時候開始，米樂告訴自己：“我也要保護季南，保護季南的家人，我一定要一直在季南身邊！”
sentences.pinyin: yě shì cóng nà shí hou kāi shǐ mǐ lè gào su zì jǐ wǒ yě yào bǎo hù jì nán bǎo hù jì nán de jiā rén wǒ yí dìng yào yì zhí zài jì nán shēn biān
sentences.english: From then on, Mi Le told himself, “I must also protect Ji Nan and protect Ji Nan’s family. I must always be at Ji Nan’s side!”

sentences.simplified: 想到了这些，米乐没有那么害怕了，他开始慢慢地找回家的路……
sentences.traditional: 想到了這些，米樂沒有那麼害怕了，他開始慢慢地找回家的路……
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào le zhè xiē mǐ lè méi yǒu nà me hài pà le tā kāi shǐ màn man de zhǎo huí jiā de lù
sentences.english: Thinking about this, Mi Le was no longer so scared. He began to slowly find his way home …

sentences.simplified: 米乐饿了，就去吃别人扔了的东西；
sentences.traditional: 米樂餓了，就去吃別人扔了的東西；
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè è le jiù qù chī bié ren rēng le de dōng xi
sentences.english: When Mi Le was hungry, he ate what others had thrown away.

sentences.simplified: 米乐渴了，就去喝地上的雨水；
sentences.traditional: 米樂渴了，就去喝地上的雨水；
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè kě le jiù qù hē dì shang de yǔ shuǐ
sentences.english: When Mi Le was thirsty, he drank rainwater on the ground.

sentences.simplified: 米乐累了，就在纸箱子里睡觉。他身上的毛现在都是黑色的了。
sentences.traditional: 米樂累了，就在紙箱子裡睡覺。他身上的毛現在都是黑色的了。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè lèi le jiù zài zhǐ xiāng zi lǐ shuì jiào tā shēn shang de máo xiàn zài dōu shì hēi sè de le
sentences.english: When Mi Le was tired, he slept in a cardboard box. The fur on his body was now all black.

sentences.simplified: 他东闻闻西闻闻，有的地方他已经去过了，但是走了几天又回到了那里。
sentences.traditional: 他東聞聞西聞聞，有的地方他已經去過了，但是走了幾天又回到了那裡。
sentences.pinyin: tā dōng wén wén xī wén wén yǒu de dì fang tā yǐ jīng qù guò le dàn shì zǒu le jǐ tiān yòu huí dào le nà lǐ
sentences.english: He sniffed around here and there. Some places he had been to before. But after a few days of walking, he returned there again.

sentences.simplified: 每一次他害怕的时候，每一次他难过的时候，每一次他不知道怎么办的时候，米乐都告诉自己季南在等他，
sentences.traditional: 每一次他害怕的時候，每一次他難過的時候，每一次他不知道怎麼辦的時候，米樂都告訴自己季南在等他，
sentences.pinyin: měi yí cì tā hài pà de shí hou měi yí cì tā nán guò de shí hou měi yí cì tā bù zhī dào zěn me bàn de shí hou mǐ lè dōu gào su zì jǐ jì nán zài děng tā
sentences.english: Every time he was afraid, every time he was sad, every time he didn’t know what to do, Mi Le told himself that Ji Nan was waiting for him.

sentences.simplified: 他觉得自己可以看见季南的脸，可以听见季南的声音：
sentences.traditional: 他覺得自己可以看見季南的臉，可以聽見季南的聲音：
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de zì jǐ kě yǐ kàn jiàn jì nán de liǎn kě yǐ tīng jiàn jì nán de shēng yīn
sentences.english: He felt that he could see Ji Nan’s face, and he could hear Ji Nan’s voice:

sentences.simplified: “米乐，快过来！我在这里。”
sentences.traditional: “米樂，快過來！我在這裡。”
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè kuài guò lái wǒ zài zhè lǐ
sentences.english: “Mi Le, come quickly! I’m here.”

sentences.simplified: “米乐，好狗，快来！我们一起玩！”
sentences.traditional: “米樂，好狗，快來！我們一起玩！”
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè hǎo gǒu kuài lái wǒ men yì qǐ wán
sentences.english: “Mi Le, good dog, come here! We’ll play together!”

sentences.simplified: “米乐，和你在一起，我太高兴了！”
sentences.traditional: “米樂，和你在一起，我太高興了！”
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè hé nǐ zài yì qǐ wǒ tài gāo xìng le
sentences.english: “Mi Le, I’m so happy to be with you!”

sentence_translations: (9) The Way Home
The child really liked Mi Le and wanted to take him home.
When he saw that the child’s mom and dad were also coming over, Mi Le was terrified.
He was not willing to go home with anyone else. He did not want a new owner.
Mi Le started running at lightning speed. He ran past everyone. He jumped over the little gate! This time, he did it!
He ran farther and farther away, farther and farther away …
Mi Le was worried and scared. Was this place far from Ji Nan’s house? Could he find his way home?
What should he eat when he’s hungry? What should he drink when he’s thirsty?
Mi Le thought about these problems. He ran into the middle of the road.
Suddenly, a car came. The car drove toward Mi Le at lightning speed. Mi Le immediately took several steps backward.
He remembered again that many years ago, he’d also run like this into the middle of the road, ..
.. and Ji Nan had run out in front of the car in order to protect him.
Many cars suddenly stopped. Mi Le saw Ji Nan on the ground. It was all red under his legs. Mi Le had been terrified then.
From then on, Mi Le told himself, “I must also protect Ji Nan and protect Ji Nan’s family. I must always be at Ji Nan’s side!”
Thinking about this, Mi Le was no longer so scared. He began to slowly find his way home …
When Mi Le was hungry, he ate what others had thrown away.
When Mi Le was thirsty, he drank rainwater on the ground.
When Mi Le was tired, he slept in a cardboard box. The fur on his body was now all black.
He sniffed around here and there. Some places he had been to before. But after a few days of walking, he returned there again.
Every time he was afraid, every time he was sad, every time he didn’t know what to do, Mi Le told himself that Ji Nan was waiting for him.
He felt that he could see Ji Nan’s face, and he could hear Ji Nan’s voice:
“Mi Le, come quickly! I’m here.”
“Mi Le, good dog, come here! We’ll play together!”
“Mi Le, I’m so happy to be with you!”
